'''Isbet Varta''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Married to [[Milosh Varta]], she lived with her husband in [[Milosh Varta's estate|his estate]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] she was visited and killed by [[Cipher Nine]], who looked for a way to locate the [[ghost cell]] by drawing out her husband, their supplier.
